name: notation
description: Capture session learnings into the right Claude Code memory tier. /notation:notate reads the session first - classifying its type, gauging volume, and identifying exercised tiers - then right-sizes the flow and announces the chosen shape. A structured scorecard + per-tier table format presents proposals across all modes. Supports a 'full' override to force the complete flow. /notation:notate-all applies every proposal without the picker. /notation:feedback sends a bug, idea, or routing correction to the maintainer as a support ticket. Ships a notation-audit skill with the same structured reporting, run against a hard size budget for the global CLAUDE.md: it measures the file, scores every finding with a signed character delta, keeps the net delta at or below zero, and relocates detail into linked note files until the projection lands under the plugin's own warning threshold (Claude Code's large-memory-file floor). Capture is backed by a measurement core: proposals are routed by size band, priced against the drafted replacement, gated before any write to the global file, and reconciled afterwards against what actually landed. Capture is budgeted from the same rules: global-tier proposals are priced in characters and the global tier closes by default once the file is at or over target. A project's own ./CLAUDE.md is deliberately looser - silent below a low floor, advisory once past it, and strictly enforced only on request or a recorded project preference. Backups are sorted by kind rather than lumped together: a run's own rollback copies are offered for cleanup once its verification passed, while your CLAUDE.md snapshot history is reported and left alone - and an existing rotation policy of your own always wins. Notation is additive: it preserves existing lines and dates new entries rather than overwriting history.
